# 🌊 Gold Coast Events Digest — 11–17 May 2026

Here is everything relevant I found across Eventbrite, Humanitix, Experience Gold Coast, Blues on Broadbeach's official site, Songkick, Inside Gold Coast, and The Urban List. Events are filtered to match your interests and sorted by date.

---

## 🎵 CONCERT / MUSIC

---

### 1. 🎸 Blues on Broadbeach 2026 — 25th Anniversary Festival ⭐ TOP PICK
- **Date:** Thu 14 May – Sun 17 May 2026 (4 days)
- **Venue:** Broadbeach precinct (streets, parks & venues), Broadbeach
- **Cost:** Mostly **FREE** (Sunday Ticket is ticketed)
- **Category:** Concert / Music
- **Source:** [bluesonbroadbeach.com](https://bluesonbroadbeach.com/) / [Experience Gold Coast](https://experiencegoldcoast.com/events/blues-on-broadbeach)

Blues on Broadbeach marks its 25th Anniversary in 2026, transforming the Gold Coast into a rhythm and blues mecca over four days. The free lineup brings together an exceptional mix of international and homegrown talent across four days of soul-stirring entertainment, set against the vibrant backdrop of parks, streets and venues throughout Broadbeach.

The 2026 lineup includes Ian Moss, Ruthie Foster, The Bamboos, MonoNeon, Robert Finley, The Lachy Doley Trio, Kevin Borich Express, Grace Cummings, Daddy Long Legs, WILSN, Hussy Hicks, Blue Shaddy, Karen Lee Andrews, Jimi Hocking, Brothers feat. Frank Sultana, Nathan Beretta & Dan Sullivan, 8 Ball Aitken's All Star Jam, and Mason Rack Band.

Returning for its third year is the Sunday Ticket featuring Australian blues powerhouse The Teskey Brothers in their festival debut, joined by Emma Donovan and Ash Grunwald.

The free four-day festival will once again transform Broadbeach into a buzzing live music hub, with multiple outdoor stages, street performances and thousands of music lovers soaking up the blues by the beach.

This is *the* event of the week — massive, multi-stage, mostly free, with a genuinely eclectic crowd of music lovers from all walks of life. Its largely free program is for families and it brings together people from all walks of life to dance, sing and groove their way through four days of entertainment with the Pacific Ocean as a backdrop.

🎟️ **Tickets:** [bluesonbroadbeach.com](https://bluesonbroadbeach.com/)

### 2. 🎤 Mi-Sex — Space Race 45th Anniversary Tour
- **Date:** Fri 15 May 2026
- **Venue:** Coolangatta Hotel, Coolangatta
- **Cost:** Ticketed (check Songkick/venue)
- **Category:** Concert / Music
- **Source:** [Songkick](https://www.songkick.com/concerts/42888182-misex-at-coolangatta-hotel)

Mi-Sex returns to the road in 2026, this time to commemorate the 45th anniversary of the band's second, timeless classic LP *Space Race*. Featuring the hit singles 'People' and 'It Only Hurts When I'm Laughing', the tour promises a catastrophic, electromagnetic collision of post-punk, the avant-garde, and new wave.

A rare chance to catch a legendary Australian new-wave act in an intimate coastal pub venue. Perfect for fans of left-field rock and genuine musical history.

🎟️ **Tickets:** [songkick.com](https://www.songkick.com/concerts/42888182-misex-at-coolangatta-hotel)

### 10. 🏛️ Gold Coast Social Work Expo 2026 ⭐ STRONG MATCH
- **Date:** Thu 14 May 2026, 9:30 AM – 1:00 PM
- **Venue:** Varsity Lakes Community Resource Centre, Varsity Lakes
- **Cost:** Free (check Eventbrite)
- **Category:** Public Lecture / Community
- **Source:** [Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/gold-coast-social-work-expo-2026-tickets-1976690549645)

The expo brings together social workers, students, community organisations, and allied-health providers to connect, learn, and showcase the depth of social work practice. The event highlights real career pathways, community partnerships, and the many systems social workers work within — while also educating the public on what social work actually is and why it matters.

An authentically community-oriented half-day event with panels, discussions and human stories. Draws thoughtful, caring professionals and students rather than a corporate crowd.

🎟️ **Tickets:** [eventbrite.com.au](https://www.eventbrite.com.au/e/gold-coast-social-work-expo-2026-tickets-1976690549645)
